first_stage.unknown: one effective positive propulsion-cost multiplier per UAV
first_stage.buoy_motion: static in primary diagnostic; prescribed drift in later stress test
first_stage.transitions: time, energy, queue arrivals, deadlines, contacts, and transport all advance during calibration
first_stage.observation: metered total energy minus audited auxiliary energy, nonoverlapping intervals
first_stage.likelihood: conditional y = z * theta + Gaussian error; validate before learning
first_stage.belief: bounded Gaussian kernel, normalized on positive support

cost_accounting.energy: all executed propulsion, radio, computation, launch, landing, and ground loads
cost_accounting.time: actual elapsed time and lost service opportunity
cost_accounting.delivery_credit: complete, unique packet at final receiver before its deadline
cost_accounting.safety: per-UAV model-conditioned return guard plus geometric guard; record empirical violations

decisive_test.varied_quantity: whether the parameter changes the preferred feasible task
decisive_test.expected_behavior_hypothesis: selective probing when decision-relevant and cost-effective

proposed_statistics.unit: independent mission; whole sequence for multi-sortie tests
proposed_statistics.confidence_interval: paired scenario-level with training-seed variability reported separately or hierarchically
